api_usage_fix_trail.note: First build of V005 used WholeReduceSum with count-mode mask and one call per span; correctness failed on every S1/S2/S3 shape (max_abs ~20) because vcadd mode=0 emits one sum per natural repeat (64 FP32), not one total for an arbitrary count. Same-revision correctness fix: two-step vector-only reduce (one sum per 64-element group, then one sum over those partials) following the production rms_norm WholeReduceSum pattern (normal bit-mask mode, mask<=64). Hypothesis unchanged: vector-output reduce with no V/S+get_acc_val+S_MTE3 chain.
